pattern for the orchestrator: a corrected keyframe that says 'applying to X only' but carries no 'to' keeps the span of shapes.csv and is unioned with the next keyframe (compile_dossiers.do_keyframe takes the union of every keyframe alive that year). Worth a grep over all dossiers for a new keyframe whose from lies inside an earlier keyframe's shapes.csv span.
